claims.statement: There exist finitely generated Hopfian A and H such that A wr H, with the standard restricted regular action, is non-Hopfian; the construction has A=C2.
boundary_checks: Finite-support base, left regular action and right multiplication orientation
Both factors Hopfian and finitely generated; the wreath product finitely generated
No assertion that the original G is Hopfian or that embedded H is finitely presented
claims.verification_status: See final THEOREM_LEDGER.md; computation controls alone do not establish imported group-ring premise.

claims.statement: OpenAI family 197's manuscript claims a finitely presented torsion-free G and a,b,c in F2[G] with ab=1, ac=0 and c nonzero, hence ba not equal to 1.
dependencies: Conditioned random matching and word estimates
Aligned block entropy and planar extraction
Relative cone-picture reductions, asphericity and root protection
limitations: No selected finite presentation or graph is generated by the arithmetic checker.
Associated Lean artifacts prove a different torsion construction and are not a formalization of this torsion-free prime-field theorem.

claims.statement: Every finitely generated group embeds in a finitely generated Hopfian group; the induced F2-group-algebra map is injective.
dependencies: Group elements form the group-ring basis
limitations: Original Miller–Schupp paper was not retrieved; the alternative accessible proof and established published framework are identified separately.
Standard deep geometric ingredients are external theorem dependencies, not independently re-proved by finite computation.

claims.statement: On F2[H]_add semidirect H, Phi(r,h)=(rb,h) is a surjective homomorphism with preimage (ra,h) and nonzero kernel lamp 1-ba.
limitations: The exact orientation control uses a bicyclic matrix ring, not a group-ring counterexample. The all-elements proof is written algebra.

boundary_checks: Axes, coincident lattice points and sign boundaries are allowed
Triangle infimum need not be attained
claims.verification_status: See final THEOREM_LEDGER.md; passing finite gates alone is insufficient.

Certified finite computations, approximation errors and unbounded tails

claims.statement: The exact triangle program satisfies Pn <= Ln squared under the conventions reconstructed in the manuscript.
limitations: A naive product of sign-changing primal functions is not used.
Bookkeeping repairs and source convention translations are written explicitly.
The comparison does not supply a universal objective-preserving conversion or triangle attainment.

claims.statement: For the unit-minimum triangular lattice, L2 >= 2/sqrt(3) and P2 >= 4/3.
dependencies: Minimum lattice norm and covolume sqrt(3)/2
limitations: Finite lattice enumeration is a boundary control, not a proof over all lattice points.
Number density 2/sqrt(3) differs from covered-area density pi/(2sqrt(3)).
